summary.intent: Complete phase 43 (FUSE write durability) remaining tasks — integrate main, run UAT against a live local stack, and then begin phase 44 (IPNS conflict handling) wrap-up work.
summary.outcome: Phase 43 branch integrated, two critical runtime bugs found and fixed (park unreachable, replay never converges first-publish failures), live headless UAT run against a full local stack, branch pushed for Windows/Linux VM UAT (Windows already passed). Phase 44's net changes were simplified via /simplify with 3 deferred cleanup todos captured.

repo: Phase 44 (feat/ipns-conflict-handling) is stacked on phase 43; a naive diff-vs-main includes stale 42/43 code — must diff against origin/feat/fuse-write-durability to isolate 44's net work.
Headless desktop auth uses --dev-key flag + /auth/test-login endpoint (email dev-key@cipherbox.local, secret e2e-test-secret-ci-only); bypasses Web3Auth for CI/agent-driven testing.
Access token TTL is 15 minutes — headless sessions exceeding this get 401s on upload; restart the app to refresh.
Journal paths per OS: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/cipherbox/cb-journal, Linux ~/.local/share/cipherbox/cb-journal, Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\cipherbox\cb-journal.
describeIf = process.env.CI ? describe.skip : describe pattern gates SDK integration tests — they fail locally without a live API seed but are skipped in CI; not real failures.
IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY is optional — jwt-issuer.service.ts generates an ephemeral RS256 keypair when unset in non-production; local stack runs fine without secrets.
Todo creation follows the GSD canonical format via gsd-tools.cjs — frontmatter fields: created/title/area/files, with gsd-generated slug.
Prettier's preferred format for release-please-config.json is the inline array form; main carried a pre-existing prettier violation that the branch merge incidentally fixed.

code.finding: replay_for_vault Err arms only logged 'will retry on next mount' — never called record_failure. Entries capped at retries=1, never reached max_retries=5, WriteParked never fired. Fixed by calling journal.record_failure(entry, &e) in both Err arms.
replay_for_vault already filters out Failed entries — correct park semantics were wired, just never reachable before the record_failure fix.

replay_upload_entry called coordinator.resolve_sequence() assuming is_first_publish=false; for files whose original upload failed before per-file IPNS creation, this errors 'IPNS name not found' forever. Fixed by detecting not-found and creating the record as first-publish (seq 0) with TEE enrollment, mirroring the live path.

Background upload runs exactly once and calls record_failure once on failure — no internal retry loop. Unit tests that called record_failure 5x directly masked the fact that entries could never organically reach the park threshold at runtime.
WriteParked logic counts Failed-status journal entries and emits WriteParked{pending, failed} — correct design, but unreachable until the record_failure fix was applied.

tee_public_key and tee_key_epoch are already in scope at the replay call site — made it feasible to add full TEE enrollment to the F3 create-on-missing fix without threading new parameters through the stack.
vi.mock('../errors') fully re-implements the module; adding a new export (is409) to errors.ts requires adding it to the mock too, otherwise the mock shadows it and 5 dependent tests fail.

workflow: macOS with both macFUSE and FUSE-T installed: pkg-config resolves 'fuse' to macFUSE (kext-based); fix by creating a fuse.pc shim that aliases to fuse-t.pc (Version 2.9.9). Without this, fuser logs 'mount confirmed' but no OS-level mount materializes — a silent false positive.

winfsp-sys and windows-future crates don't build on macOS — Windows-specific desktop code (windows/mod.rs edits) can only be compile-verified on a Windows box or CI (desktop-e2e.yml, windows-latest runner).
The authoritative local stack recipe is .github/workflows/desktop-e2e.yml — mirrors exactly what CI does and avoids subtle env differences.
Merging main into a stacked branch: conflicts are entirely predictable — only files modified by both phases conflict; resolve toward main for the earlier phase's finalized files.

lint-staged with prettier can reject a deletion-only commit as 'empty' if prettier reformats the only modified file back to its original state before staging — check git status carefully before diagnosing a hook as broken.
When a stacked branch can't be finalized, /simplify can still be applied to the net diff (git diff base-branch...HEAD) and the cleanup commits will survive the eventual rebase cleanly.

friction: macFUSE vs FUSE-T conflict took significant debugging time — fuser reported 'mount confirmed' even with the wrong library, masking the real failure until inspecting the fuse-t daemon logs and running strings on the binary.
15-minute access token TTL caused a 401 mid-UAT, requiring a full app restart and re-run of the write sanity test.
winfsp path cannot be compiled or runtime-tested on macOS, leaving the F3 edit to windows/mod.rs unverified until the user ran it on a Windows VM.
lint-staged reformatted release-please-config.json after checkout-main resolved it, causing the cleanup commit to be rejected as empty — required understanding prettier's preferred format to resolve.
The zsh glob in a Bash tool call (*.json before any files existed) aborted a multi-step crash-test sequence early, requiring re-run.
FUSE-T mount wedged after a force-unmount mid-session, blocking a clean relaunch until the stale go-nfsv4 process was killed manually.
Phase 44 cannot be finalized until phase 43 lands on main due to stacking — adds sequencing overhead.
Adding is409 export to errors.ts broke 5 existing tests because vi.mock('../errors') fully shadows the module and didn't include the new export.
